We need to find a template that matches retrosynthetic step for HWE reaction. The forward reaction: aldehyde/ketone + phosphonate carbanion -> alkene (E) + aliphatic carboxylic acid (from phosphonate). So broken bonds: C-P (phosphonate) and C-O (maybe the O of the phosphonate? Actually the phosphonate is attached to carbonyl? In HWE, the phosphonate is attached to carbonyl group (phosphonate ester). The reaction breaks C-P bond and C-O bond (the O of the carbonyl? Actually the carbonyl oxygen becomes part of the acid). Anyway.

We need to search template catalog with appropriate functional groups. The tool expects functional groups from list. We need to use valid names: "C-P" not in list. Maybe "phosphonate" not in list. The list includes "trimethylsilyl", "t-butyldimethylsilyl". Not helpful.

Maybe we can search without functional groups broken/formed, just using bonds formed. Let's try search with bonds_formed "C=C". Also maybe bonds_broken "C-P". But C-P not allowed. So omit.

Search with bonds_formed "C=C". Also maybe functional_groups_formed "C-C double bonds". That's allowed. Let's try.
